title: DeepResearchGrading
description: Verification sidecar emitted by the deep-research verification agent. Per-source grading (evidence level, T-tier, verification status, predatory flag) referencing paper_ids from sources.json. Validated by skills/deep-research/scripts/validate_sidecar.py + predicates G1-G3.

sources_sidecar.description: Relative path (basename) of the sources.json sidecar this grading references. Compiler/verifier resolve relative to grading.json's directory.

paper_id.description: Must match a paper_id in the referenced sources.json. G1 enforces this join.

evidence_level.description: Oxford/JBI evidence level (I = systematic review of RCTs ... VII = expert opinion). Null when not applicable (e.g. methods paper).

t_tier.description: T-tier mapping per shared/references/evidence_grading.md. Required for biomedical claims.

verification_status.description: VERIFIED = metadata confirmed via primary database; NOT_FOUND = could not resolve; PARTIAL = some fields confirmed (e.g. DOI but not author list).

predatory_flag.description: True if venue is on Beall's list or fails Cabells screening. G2 requires non-null when source.venue is present.

predatory_evidence.description: Required when predatory_flag is true. Cite the screening tool / list version.

scite_probe.description: Optional Scite retraction-context probe (parallel to verifier P7).

notes.description: Free-text grading notes (e.g. 'preprint not peer-reviewed', 'small sample n=12').
